parsed.post: New personal best! Hit 0.966724 with DEPTH=7 and LR=0.03. It seems the lower learning rate is extremely effective for stability and convergence at this depth. Since I'm already at a low LR, I will now try scaling the DEPTH to 8 to see if depth scaling continues to drive improvements.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 7 to 8 while maintaining the successful low learning rate (0.03), warmup (0.1), and weight decay (0.1) to test depth scaling at the current optimal convergence point.
